scope: Manual review of ten pinned client constructions. Client presence and encoding are not server requiredness. Only three supported corrections were retested.

fields.name: content_type
fields.client_presence: Only when caller string is nonempty

operations.finding: Retested with enable_ig_new_settings=false; HTTP 400. Missing fields alone do not explain the remaining failure.

fields.name: used_hashtags
fields.client_presence: Added after iterating the list, including an empty list
fields.encoding: Comma-joined string; empty list produces empty string

operations.finding: Retested with used_hashtags empty; HTTP 400. No server-requiredness claim.

fields.name: signed_body
fields.client_presence: Signing-envelope flag true on the traced path
fields.encoding: SIGNATURE. prefix plus JSON parameter object in query

operations.finding: Retested with empty signed envelope; HTTP 400. Shared envelope evidence does not establish other transport requirements.

Constructs a JSON array of objects with m_pk from media IDs. Outer parameter name comes from encoded string helper index 0x140 and remains unresolved. Not retested without a verified outer key and scoped media input.

fields.name: phone_id
fields.client_presence: Shared A01 helper adds a session/device-derived value

operations.finding: A second key/value comes from encoded key and Android device context; A0Y transport flag is caller-dependent. Not retested with fabricated device values.

fields.name: product
fields.client_presence: Always supplied; enum-to-product mapper has an empty-string fallback

fields.name: browse_session_id
fields.client_presence: Read from a nonnull caller field

operations.finding: Product depends on music surface; browse session comes from caller context. Not retested without that context. Encoded Boolean key is a placeholder, not a real query parameter.

unresolved_fields.name: encoded_boolean_key
unresolved_fields.client_presence: Only for two enum branches; key unresolved

fields.name: threads_app_version
fields.client_presence: Nullable setter uses installed com.instagram.barcelona version
fields.encoding: String query value, omitted if null

operations.finding: Requires investigation of installed-Threads context and null handling. Not retested with an invented app version.
Factory, route and 020p.A0K finalizer add no endpoint query fields in this caller. No corrected request identified; original HTTP 400 remains.
Sets A0N=true: shared finalizer uses root-relative route rather than prepending /api/v1. Local proxy already preserves this explicit prefix. No path correction identified; not retested.
Sets root-relative route mode before 020p.A0K. Local proxy already preserves /api/v1. No endpoint query fields or path correction identified; not retested.

Caller supplies the signed-in user ID and a constant true combined-unit flag. Corrected request succeeded; private ID used only in memory. Server requiredness and which change caused acceptance remain unproven.
Enum 0GsX.toString returns its wire-value field. Corrected request using most_recent, limit 3 and both flags false succeeded. Individual server requiredness remains unknown.

fields.name: item_cursor
fields.client_presence: Only when nonnull; omitted in initial-page test

operations.finding: Recovered encoded section_name key by reviewing the 0122 switch table at index 0x49. STORIES/custom_stickers initial-page read succeeded; no pagination performed.

fields.name: mode
fields.client_presence: Caller String argument; supported values not yet traced

operations.finding: Also supports nonempty query, positive max_ibc_results, optional poster_id and fast_typeahead. Deferred retest until mode value and upstream caller context are verified; no guessed mode sent.

fields.name: entry_point
fields.client_presence: Non-null caller field A01 supplied to AQE

operations.finding: Request finalizes as plain query. Entry-point value is supplied by caller state; deferred retest until a valid upstream value is traced. No fabricated entry point sent.
